headline: Fresh Fighting Rattles the Divided Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the heaviest action has concentrated in Weathered Expanse, Callahan’s Passage, and Deadlands. Weathered Expanse recorded 46 strategic-base events in 24 hours, including five in the latest two, while its ledger now shows five Warden-held, three Colonial-held, and one neutral base; casualties and enlistments are accelerating. Callahan’s Passage has become a fresh hot spot, with two events in two hours and nine across the day, alongside sharply rising casualty and enlistment rates; nine of its ten bases remain Warden-held and one is neutral. Deadlands has also quickened, posting 16 events—three recently—and now stands at eleven Colonial-held bases. Stlican Shelf remains the busiest divided sector by total movement, with 38 events, five in six hours, and an eight-to-one Warden advantage in the current ledger. Linn Mercy reports 19 events, including two recent, with seven Colonial and four Warden bases. Godcrofts has cooled from its earlier burst but still logged 21 events and four in six hours; all nine bases are presently Colonial-held despite a mixed recent record. Fisherman’s Row has gone quiet since its earlier contests.
